confounding_statement: H0->H1 is a WHOLE-SYSTEM comparison. The only intended generation-time difference is the system prompt (v1->v2: KEY RULE + PRIORITY RULE). An uncontrolled temporal/provider confound also exists (same model snapshot, different wall-clock). All accounting/validity/authorization/QA differences are applied uniformly at analysis time or are non-generative execution controls. This design does NOT identify the causal contribution of any individual repair. No improvement or degradation may be attributed to a specific repair without a controlled ablation.
